SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM ( SELECT curdate( ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 2 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 3 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 4 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 5 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 6 DAY ) AS timeNode ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(start_time) date, start_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_union_task WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), start_time ) <= 7 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

select a.month as timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 4 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 8 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 9 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 10 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` )a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m') timeNode, count(union_id) as count FROM t_union_task GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m')) b on a.month = b.timeNode order by timeNode

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ac-1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') as timeNode FROM ( SELECT @ai:=@ai+1 as ac from (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) ac1, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6) ac2, (SELECT @ai:=0) xc0 ) c )a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(start_time) date, start_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_union_task WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), start_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode
